rows.letter: You need software that can distinguish lobby waiting from actual gameplay and bind usage to a copy‑proof USB key—what game platforms are you targeting first? I delivered a production‑grade Python/FastAPI system that cut first‑response time by 43% [case_proj_63b2db4ed7]. The installer will be a single‑click package that registers the service, writes the USB driver, and sets up a lightweight Electron‑based UI that shows per‑game and per‑session hour breakdowns. Could you confirm the primary operating systems (Windows, macOS) and whether you prefer a HID or U2F authentication method for the USB device?

You need a Dockerized FastAPI service on a GPU‑enabled EC2 instance that actually runs the Vision Transformer on the GPU. I delivered a production FastAPI + Docker system that raised search click‑through by 48% [case_proj_4058dfe795]. My plan is: 1. Start the chosen EC2 instance and run `nvidia‑smi` inside a test container to confirm driver visibility. 2. Create a Dockerfile based on the NVIDIA CUDA runtime, install matching CUDA/cuDNN packages, and enable the `--gpus all` runtime. 3. Modify the FastAPI code to move the Vision Transformer model to `torch.device('cuda')` and add a health‑check endpoint that returns `torch.cuda.is_available()`. 4. Add a lightweight test script that loads the model, asserts GPU availability, runs a sample inference, and logs latency and memory usage. 5. Produce concise documentation of every command, Dockerfile snippet, and test output for reproducibility.

I recently rebuilt a reporting pipeline, cutting refresh time from a day to 26 minutes [case_proj_d007e6392d]. Hourly execution will be orchestrated with Cloud Scheduler or Airflow, leveraging retries and dependency ordering proven in prior migrations.

You need an interactive web visualizer that lets users preview floor designs with high visual fidelity and e‑commerce integration. Will the texture swapping need to work on mobile browsers as well as desktop? In a recent real‑estate project I built a computer‑vision system that caught 18% of floor‑related defects before packing [case_proj_0b0ecbd92e]. My full‑stack background includes Django, React, TypeScript, Stripe and WebGL, enabling me to deliver both the ML backend and a Three.js front‑end [cv_fullstack_web]. The UI will be fully responsive, render flooring textures at high fidelity, and integrate smoothly with your e‑commerce workflow. Let me know if you prefer a mobile‑first implementation for texture swapping.

You need someone to take ownership of your landing page system, polish the existing templates, add new sections, and deliver a visually perfect UX. You need an automated process that pulls call‑log data from Ringba, Facebook, and Excel spreadsheets into a database for Looker Studio. Which CRM platform are you using and does it provide a REST API for extracting the call‑log records? I also routinely ingest Excel data using automated scripts, cleaning and loading it into databases, as shown in my survey data cleaning work [code_proj_1556717424]. That survey project processed 111 responses and delivered a production system for reporting [case_proj_1556717424].

Could you describe how your current Stripe Connect flow processes webhook events for successful payouts? The solution will be cost-effective, reusing proven components from the above projects [case_proj_19fcdf8f80, case_proj_a3b70b59d4] for you.
